boundary_note: These layers control which of YOUR bots/agents can read or write which of YOUR repo data, and what needs human sign-off before it goes public. They do not create a zone where any AI model operates without its own safety rules — no config file can do that, on any platform.

Collaboration.description: Dev repo — agents propose changes via PR, human merges

Draft.description: Work-in-progress notes and unpublished drafts. Not yet reviewed, so not shown publicly or auto-exported. Still subject to each agent's normal safety rules — this only controls WHEN it becomes visible, not WHAT the agent will produce.
